name.ja: Figure-rise Standard アマテ・ユズリハ(マチュ)

description.ja: 『機動戦士Gundam GQuuuuuuX』(ジークアクス)より、主人公「アマテ・ユズリハ(マチュ)」がFigure-rise Standardシリーズにラインアップ！
description.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam GQuuuuuuX ", the main character " Amate Yuzuriha (Machu)" is now available in the Figure-rise Standard series!

description.ja: • 豊富な表情はタンポ印刷済みパーツ1種と、水転写式デカール用パーツ2種が付属。
description.en: • Includes 1 type of tampo-printed part and 2 types of water transfer decal parts for a rich variety of expressions.

description.ja: • 髪のインナーカラーはパーツ分割により再現。
description.en: • The inner color of the hair is reproduced by dividing the parts.

description.ja: • 制服はカーディガン着用のほか、半袖の制服を再現できるパーツが付属。
description.en: • In addition to wearing a cardigan, the uniform includes parts that can reproduce short-sleeved uniforms.

description.ja: • スカートにはポージングの幅が広がる軟質素材を採用。
description.en: • The skirt is made of soft material that allows for a wider range of poses.

description.ja: • リュックは着脱が可能。
• 帽子が取り外しできるハロがセット。
description.en: • Includes a halo with a removable hat.

description.ja: • スマホパーツと専用の持ち手が付属。
description.en: • Includes smartphone parts and special handle.

accessories.ja: 表情パーツ(タンポ印刷)×1種
accessories.en: Facial expression parts (tampo printing) x 1 type

accessories.ja: 表情パーツ(水転写式デカール用)×2種
accessories.en: Facial expression parts (for water transfer decals) x 2 types
Short sleeve uniform parts x 1 set
